description: Newly issued building permits with address, permit type, description, contractor, job value and issue date, filtered by area, category, city, zip, distance from a point or zip, multi-trade projects, dates and minimum value, newest first or sorted by job value or urgency. Up to 100 per call. Costs $0.40 in USDC (x402; Base, Solana, Polygon or Arbitrum); no charge when nothing matches.

category.description: Permit category, e.g. roof, pool, solar, hvac, new_residential

includeRenewals.description: Include New York renewals of existing permits (left out by default)

jurisdiction.description: Area id, e.g. new-york-ny, miami-dade-fl. Use list_coverage for names.

multiTrade.description: Only permits at addresses with another type of permit within 90 days (usually bigger projects)

near.description: Only permits near a zip code in the area or a "lat,lng" point

sort.description: newest first (default), highest job value first, or urgent permits first

name: search_permits
title: Search building permits
